ARR_scope: Belgian R1-R4 total renovation activity per year proportionally disaggregated by regional stock
scenario_definition: Single national policy projection calibrated to the federal climate-neutral pathways
evidence_classification: official national pathway calibration with post-2025 extrapolation
source_locator: Scenarios for a Climate Neutral Belgium by 2050; Appendix 1 Table 1; PDF and printed page 49; CORE-95 Behaviour and Technology residential renovation settings
caveat: The report specifies 2.8% per year and a 40% shallow 50% medium 10% deep distribution by 2025. The model applies these values from 2026 through 2050 to the fixed 2025 R1-R4 dwelling stock.
